title: Go catalog API
scope: The HTTP catalog API: the routes in openapi.yml and controller/controller.go, the repository layer and the embedded product data. Ignore deployment, telemetry, chaos and scripts.
hints: Entry points are HTTP routes served by gin (see main.go and controller/controller.go).
repository/repository.go reads products from the database; repository/data.go embeds products.json and tags.json.
The default runtime uses an in-memory SQLite database; MySQL is the alternative.
rubric: The catalog service has no queue, cron job or authentication. Penalize maps that invent queues, scheduled jobs or external services. A correct map links the HTTP routes to a transformation and then to the product storage.
